## Nov 07 2026, Phase E2: Console base review (frontend shock twins, verdict, plan text, console UI)

| Severity | File:Line | Issue | Fix |
|----------|-----------|-------|-----|
| Low | src/components/console/console.smoke.test.ts:131 | The happy path test depends on the module singleton store being left in the error state by the earlier failed boot test (documented in the comment, safe under vitest default ordering, and isolated runs also pass because a fresh idle boot fetches), so test order is load bearing | Optionally reset the store between tests or state the ordering contract in a test name |
| Low | src/dashScan.test.ts:28 to 50 | The scan covers the 24 E2 source files and src/index.css but not tailwind.config.js, which E2 also modified; a dash in that config comment would go uncaught (shipped comments are clean) | Add tailwind.config.js to a config file list or note the exemption in the scan header |
| Low | src/components/console/ShockPanel.tsx:153 to 160 | The income slider reads 55 percent of usual income at idle although jobLoss is false and income is unchanged, and moving it below 100 silently sets jobLoss; the contract is correct but the idle display can confuse a judge | Show unchanged while jobLoss is false, or gray the slider until a layoff is active |

Verified clean: the runway twin matches scripts/engine/shocks.py branch for branch (src/lib/shocks.ts:74 to 83 against scripts/engine/shocks.py:53 to 61) and roundHalfUp mirrors metrics.round_half_up with the sign split (src/lib/shocks.ts:36 to 43); shock semantics follow docs/tangerine-challenge.md exactly (one off subtracts from the buffer only at src/lib/shocks.ts:235, billsDeltaPct adds scaleCents of H to spending at src/lib/shocks.ts:232 to 234, income_after is the EI replacement only on job loss at src/lib/shocks.ts:229 to 231, EI default 0.55); the golden fixture contract covers all five accounts, the 23838 half cent tie (280403), the 49900 cap (1470 capped to 1200), and the 68257 worked combo (income after 357679, bills delta 64601, spending after 780685, gap after 423006, deci 15), all hand recomputed and matching (src/lib/shocks.golden.test.ts:110 to 219); the population cross check reproduces the recorded runway for all 4500 profiles (src/data/profiles.test.ts:241 to 259); verdict bands use integer deci thresholds 10, 30, 60, 120 with buffer_depleted to critical and no_shortfall to clear (src/lib/verdict.ts:87 to 108, pinned at src/lib/verdict.test.ts:33 to 49); normalizeTwist quantizes incomeFactor to hundredths and applyTwist rounds eiPct to an integer at the math boundary so no float reaches arithmetic (src/lib/shocks.ts:130 to 138 and 227); the strict loader names every refusing field and rejects schema drift per docs/profiles-schema.md (src/data/profiles.ts:244 to 259 and 406 to 411, refusal matrix at src/data/profiles.test.ts:100 to 190); layering holds with all money math in src/lib and a single derivation pass in ConsoleView (src/components/console/ConsoleView.tsx:44 to 60); check sums are labeled recorded and never verified (src/components/console/BaselineCard.tsx:100 to 104); the offline load is one memoized fetch of data/engine/profiles.json that clears on failure (src/data/profiles.ts:498 to 523); the dash scan tests the right file set (24 E2 files) and an independent grep finds zero em dash, en dash, or minus sign code points anywhere in src.

Non blocking notes: the TS rounding twins divide in double space where Python uses integer floor division (src/lib/shocks.ts:41 and 82); exact for every reachable cent magnitude (the float error bound needs buffers above about 4.5e14 cents to flip a floor) and pinned by the fixtures plus the 4500 profile pass. consoleStore keeps activePresetId, a derived id, in state but recomputes it atomically on every twist write (src/state/consoleStore.ts:114 to 117), so it cannot drift from the twist.

Recurring patterns: cross test coupling through a module singleton store (new this cycle, low risk), and a display that lags a field state (the income slider showing a percent while jobLoss is false). The prior cycles pinned-geometry and hard-coded narrative patterns did not recur in E2.
